notes.title: Drops Hotfix Confirmation
notes.notes:
With a lot of backend stuff that needed to be sorted out we can now confirm that drops are working correctly.
Please download the update and restart your game for the fix to work and for some to receive their duck reward after a shortened delay.

This is our first Steam game, yet we already received a lot of positive feedback.
Thank you for understanding and see you in the pond,
DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)!

notes.title: DUCKS Launch Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi!
We encountered a bug that prevented some players from receiving the right amount of ducks for their playtime. With today's update we believe we found and solved the issue.
Now everyone should be getting the right amount of ducks and some people will experience a tremendous boost to their drops.

See you in the pond,
DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)!

notes.title: DUCKS GLOBAL RELEASE
notes.notes:
Long awaited DUCKS is finally out!
Hop in the game now for a chance to receive a Launch only duck!
This event will last for three days only!

We have a lot of updates and features already in the works. Those features include:
- class system - different classes will boost your duck drops in different ways
- crafting system - craft items to boost your progress and drops
- leveling system - level through 3 classes to unlock new items and ways to boost your progression, quality and quantity of items dropped

We are VERY excited to finally release our game and can't wait to work on it further!

See you in the pond,
DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)!
